layout.footerTagline: Book with confidence — fast search, secure stays.
layout.teamTagline: No Mercy No Doubt tourism booking platform.

home.title: Find your next stay in Palestine, fast.
home.lead: Search trusted stays, compare room types, check live availability, and book in minutes with a smooth, mobile-first experience.
home.mapTitle: Every stay, plotted in one view
home.mapLead: Browse live pins for hotels across the region — tap a label to open details, or jump to the full map for filters.
home.sectionTitle: Everything you need to book with confidence
home.featureSearchBody: Search by city, dates, and guests. Compare hotels and room types with clear details.
home.featureBookingBody: Instant booking flow with availability checks and a smooth mock payment experience.
home.featureManagerBody: Manage your own hotels and room types, and review upcoming bookings in one dashboard.
home.promoBody: Book your hotel in minutes, compare prices clearly, and choose the stay that suits you — without fuss.
home.whyCardFastBody: From search to booking in minutes with simple, clear steps.
home.whyCardClearBody: Clear prices and details visible before you confirm your booking.
home.whyCardSmartBody: Suggestions tailored to destination and budget to help you pick the right hotel.
home.whyCardTrustedBody: Locally selected hotels for an easier, more comfortable stay.

hotels.mapPageHint: Pins use latitude and longitude from each hotel. Tap a name for a quick summary, then open the hotel to book.
hotels.mapsApiKeyMissing: Set VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY in your frontend .env to show the map (Maps JavaScript API enabled for that key).
hotels.mapsLoadError: Google Maps failed to load. Check the API key and billing for the Maps JavaScript API.
hotels.mapNoPins: Hotels here have no coordinates yet. Managers can add latitude and longitude when creating hotels.
hotels.mapCoordsInvalidPlaceholder: Coordinates look like placeholders (for example 0° and 0° point to the Atlantic). Edit each hotel in the dashboard with real latitude and longitude (e.g. Bethlehem ~ 31.7, 35.2).
hotels.mapSomeCoordsSkipped: Some hotels had invalid coordinates and were skipped; others are shown.
hotels.noResultsBody: Try another city or another filter.

hotelDetail.mapNotAvailable: There is no usable map location for this hotel yet. The manager can add valid latitude and longitude in the dashboard (not 0°, 0°).
hotelDetail.defaultDescription: Comfortable rooms in a convenient city location.
hotelDetail.quoteHint: Choose a room to see availability and price breakdown.
hotelDetail.mockPaymentDisclaimer: This is a mock payment. Your data is not stored.
hotelDetail.alertNotifyEmailHint: When this alert fires, you will receive an in-app notification and an email sent to your account address (if outbound mail is configured on the server).

profile.errorUpload: Upload failed. Check Storage policies and the "avatars" bucket.
profile.errorPublicUrl: Could not get a public URL for the upload.
profile.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
